name: d365fo-agent-desktop
description: Desktop app and installer for the D365FO Agent: Open WebUI chat plus the settings app in one window, no Docker or Node needed.

scripts.dist: npm run stage && npm run uv && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:release: node scripts/check-release.mjs && npm run stage && npm run uv && electron-builder --config electron-builder.release.yml --publish never
